resources.string: Please grant the \'Do Not Disturb\' permission
The \'Do Not Disturb\' permission is required to set the phone to Silent Mode. Please allow the app to use this permission.
The next screen will display a list of apps. Please select \'Quick Settings Sound Profile\' and allow the app to use this permission.
You\'re all set and ready to go!
Place the sound tile in your quick settings panel and toggle between the different sound profiles.
Could not create rule for silent mode.
When Silent Mode is activated via the Quick Settings Tile

When Silent Mode is enabled, only media (e.g., music, videos) and alarms will sound. Note that this applies only if Silent Mode was toggled via the app\’s Quick Settings tile. This behavior can be changed on Android 15 or higher but is not recommended, as it bypasses the silent state and may result in unwanted vibrations.

Your device doesn\'t support user-managed modes. This means your device will automatically apply a standard \'Do Not Disturb\' schedule with the app\'s default settings mentioned above whenever Silent Mode is active. However, you won\'t be able to customize its specific behavior.
